strictModeDesc: Timer will be suspend if the window lost focus while the strict mode activated.
progressTrackingDesc: Optional. Record how much of a note each reading covered; this does not estimate understanding, memory, or mastery.
leaderboardNoData: No data available, start reading now!
leaderboardNoData2: Only notes with study time greater than 1 minute are counted
analyticsLoadError: Unable to load statistics. Please reopen the dashboard.
studyOverviewDesc: An Anki-inspired view of note-reading behavior, without mastery, forgetting, or card-difficulty estimates.
hourlyDistributionDesc: Find your most active study hours
sessionLengthDistributionDesc: Compare brief visits with deep reading
recentSessionsDesc: The 30 most recently completed reading sessions
heatmapAriaLabel: Study activity during the past 365 days
sessionHistoryDesc: Review and correct completed reading sessions. Changes update totals, daily statistics, and rankings.
deleteSessionConfirm: Delete this session and subtract its duration and open count from all statistics? A safety backup is created first.
sessionNotePathDesc: Vault-relative path to a Markdown note or PDF.
sessionInvalidNote: Choose an existing Markdown note or PDF.
sessionInvalidTime: Enter a valid start time and non-negative duration.
restoreBackupConfirm: Replace the current plugin data with the latest valid backup? Current data is not merged.
backupPrivacyNote: Backups stay in this vault and contain note paths and study timestamps. Your existing vault sync may copy them.
backupLoadError: The backup could not be read. No data was changed.
actionFailed: The operation failed. No study data was intentionally changed.
progressMeaning: Coverage is your own record of how much content you reached this time. The cumulative display is capped at 100% and does not mean absorption, understanding, or mastery.
progressThisReadingDesc: Enter the percentage of the whole note covered during this reading (0–100).
progressActiveDurationDesc: Uses the current session duration when available; you may correct it with minutes or HH:MM:SS.
progressInvalid: Enter a valid note, time, positive percentage up to 100, and non-negative duration.
deleteProgressConfirm: Delete this reading coverage entry? A safety backup will be created first.
progressDisabledDesc: This feature is off by default. Enable it to record coverage from a note or the Command Palette and explore aggregate statistics.
coverageHeatmapDesc: Based on self-reported reading coverage per day
coverageHourlyDesc: Find when you most often advance through content
folderCoverageDesc: Weighted by note characters when available; otherwise averaged by note
progressHistoryDesc: Review, edit, or delete each reading coverage entry
feedbackDescription: Tell us what is difficult to use, which statistics look inaccurate, or what you would like in a future release. The plugin sends no data automatically; only content you explicitly submit on GitHub is sent.
feedbackBugDesc: Interface errors, unresponsive actions, installation, or compatibility problems.
feedbackAccuracyDesc: Reading time, opens, sessions, rankings, or totals do not match what you expected.
feedbackFeatureDesc: Describe the problem you want to solve and how the plugin could help.
feedbackDiscussionDesc: Use Discussions when you are unsure whether something is a bug or want to explore an idea first.
feedbackPrivacyDesc: The feedback forms are hosted by GitHub and require a GitHub login. Repository maintainers receive the submission in GitHub notifications and may receive email according to their GitHub settings.
feedbackPrivacyNames: Replace private note titles, paths, and contents with anonymous examples.
feedbackPrivacyData: Do not upload plugin data.json, your whole vault, or unredacted screenshots containing private information.
feedbackPrivacySubmit: A button only opens the form. Nothing is sent until you explicitly submit it.
